faq.heading: Seedance Video Enhancer FAQs
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about video quality, supported formats, processing, downloads, and privacy.

items.question: What does the Seedance Video Enhancer do?
items.answer: It improves the resolution, sharpness, and overall clarity of Seedance-generated videos while reducing visible blur and noise.

items.question: Does it support Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 videos?
items.answer: Yes. The tool is designed to enhance videos generated with both Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5.

items.question: Can it upscale a Seedance video to HD or UHD?
items.answer: The tool can produce a higher-resolution HD or UHD result when supported. Final quality depends on the resolution and visual detail of the original video.

items.question: Which video formats can I upload?
items.answer: You can upload MP4, MOV, and WebM video files. Unsupported formats must be converted before uploading.

items.question: Can it fix blurry faces and fast-motion scenes?
items.answer: It can sharpen facial details and improve motion clarity, but results vary. Severe blur, compression artifacts, or missing details may not be fully recoverable.

items.question: Will the enhanced video keep its original audio?
items.answer: Yes. The enhancement process focuses on visual quality while retaining the video’s existing audio track.

items.question: How long does video enhancement take?
items.answer: Processing time depends on the video’s length, resolution, file size, and current demand. Short Seedance clips are generally completed faster.

items.question: Is the Seedance Video Enhancer free?
items.answer: Yes. You can enhance, preview, and download your video without credits or a paid subscription. Registration and login are required.

items.question: Does enhancement remove the Seedance watermark?
items.answer: No. This tool improves video quality and resolution; it is not designed to remove watermarks or ownership information.

items.question: Are my uploaded Seedance videos private?
items.answer: Yes. Files use private storage and temporary access links. Uploaded videos, enhanced results, and processing records are scheduled for deletion after 24 hours.
